events.title: Child emperor Leo II crowns his father Zeno co-emperor
events.description: Seven-year-old Leo II, sole emperor since his grandfather's death in January, crowned his father Zeno as co-ruler. Leo died that November, leaving Zeno to rule alone.
events.html: Seven-year-old Leo II, sole emperor since his grandfather's death in January, crowned his father Zeno as co-ruler. Leo died that November, leaving Zeno to rule alone.

events.title: Earliest recorded race is run at Chester
events.description: A Shrove Tuesday race on the Roodee at Chester is the first recorded at what is now Britain's oldest racecourse still in use. It replaced a violent football match as the city's holiday sport.
events.html: A Shrove Tuesday race on the Roodee at Chester is the first recorded at what is now Britain's oldest racecourse still in use. It replaced a violent football match as the city's holiday sport.

events.title: Parliament declares Massachusetts in rebellion
events.description: Both Houses of Parliament declared Massachusetts in a state of rebellion and asked the King to enforce the law. Fighting broke out at Lexington and Concord two months later.
events.html: Both Houses of Parliament declared Massachusetts in a state of rebellion and asked the King to enforce the law. Fighting broke out at Lexington and Concord two months later.

events.title: Jefferson Davis elected provisional President of the Confederacy
events.description: Meeting in Montgomery, the Confederate provisional Congress chose Davis, a former Mississippi senator and US Secretary of War. He led the Confederacy throughout the Civil War.
events.html: Meeting in Montgomery, the Confederate provisional Congress chose Davis, a former Mississippi senator and US Secretary of War. He led the Confederacy throughout the Civil War.

events.title: Joseph McCarthy claims to have a list of communists in the State Department
events.description: In a speech at Wheeling, West Virginia, the Wisconsin senator said he held a list of 205 communists in the State Department. The charge launched years of anti-communist investigations.
events.html: In a speech at Wheeling, West Virginia, the Wisconsin senator said he held a list of 205 communists in the State Department. The charge launched years of anti-communist investigations.

events.title: Soviet R-7 becomes the first operational ICBM
events.description: The R-7 Semyorka, the rocket that had launched Sputnik, entered service as the world's first intercontinental ballistic missile. Its descendants still launch Soyuz spacecraft.
events.html: The R-7 Semyorka, the rocket that had launched Sputnik, entered service as the world's first intercontinental ballistic missile. Its descendants still launch Soyuz spacecraft.

events.title: The Beatles appear on 'The Ed Sullivan Show'
events.description: An estimated 73 million Americans watched the Beatles' first live US television appearance. The broadcast launched the 'British Invasion' of American popular music.
